intro: I help brands build their online presence through strategic content management, engaging storytelling, community development and data-driven social media strategies.
about_text: I am a Social Media Manager and Community Manager with practical experience managing digital platforms, developing engaging content and monitoring performance. My approach combines creativity, strategic planning and data-driven decision-making to help brands build meaningful online communities and achieve measurable growth.
